title: Memotion 3: Dataset on Sentiment and Emotion Analysis of codemixed Hindi-English Memes
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting hate speech and harmful content in memes, which is an applied task related to ethical content moderation. However, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as core components of an LLM or a dataset, nor does it delve into theological or philosophical aspects of these concepts.
